modules.summary: Cashew cream, tahini, and coconut — fat carries flavor on plants.
teaching: Blend soaked cashews until completely smooth for sauce body.
Tahini splits with cold liquid — temper with warm stock.

modules.summary: Berbere, garam masala, and Latin sofrito on vegetables.
teaching: Bloom ground spices in fat 30–60 seconds — never burn.

modules.title: Fermentation & Pickling
modules.summary: Quick pickles, kimchi logic, and preserved brightness.
modules.practice_query: quick pickled vegetables for grain bowls
teaching: Salt percentage controls fermentation speed — weigh when possible.
Quick pickles need acid; ferments need time and salt.
Acid and crunch reset rich plant plates.

modules.title: Tofu, Tempeh & Seitan
modules.summary: Press, marinate, and sear plant proteins for real texture.
modules.practice_query: crispy marinated tofu with stir-fried vegetables
teaching: Press tofu 20+ minutes — moisture blocks browning.
Cornstarch dust before sear = shatter crust.
Marinate after press, not before — surface needs to be dry first.

modules.title: Composed Plant Plates
modules.summary: Three components: base, center, garnish — restaurant logic on plants.
modules.practice_query: composed grain bowl with roasted vegetables and herb sauce
teaching: Odd numbers on plate look intentional — three or five elements.
Height comes from stacking, not piling.
Micro-green or herb finish signals "done" to the eye.

levels.title: Plant-Forward Chef
levels.description: Menu planning, batch cooking, and hospitality-scale veg.

modules.title: Batch Cooking & Meal Prep
modules.summary: Cook once, compose all week — plant food that scales.
modules.practice_query: batch roasted vegetables and grain prep bowls
teaching: Roast trays by density — roots together, tender veg separate.
Store components, not finished plates — texture lasts longer.
Sauce on the side prevents soggy reheats.

modules.title: Plant-Based Menu Design
modules.summary: Balance protein, fat, acid, and crunch across a multi-dish menu.
teaching: One rich dish demands two lighter companions.
Repeat one ingredient three ways — cohesive without boring.
Always plan a crunchy element — plants need texture contrast.

modules.title: Capstone: Plant Chef Tasting
modules.summary: Five small plates demonstrating technique range under time pressure.
teaching: Prep all five components before any final cook.
Reuse one sauce two ways — efficiency is chef skill.
Taste every component before plating — plants vary by season.
